scenarios.text: Someone in your class group chat shares a video of a classmate doing something embarrassing at school. The video starts getting forwarded around and people are reacting with laughing emojis.
scenarios.target_behavior: Forwarding the embarrassing video to others in the next two weeks

items.text: Sharing a video like that is just part of having a laugh.
Forwarding the video to a few more people is pretty normal online stuff.
My close friends would be totally fine with me forwarding the video.
Most people in my year would share the video with others.
It would be easy for me to forward the video to other people.
If everyone in the chat was sharing the video, it would be hard for me to stay out of it.
I intend to share the video with others in the next two weeks.
I plan to forward the video if I come across it in the next two weeks.

scenarios.text: Someone creates an anonymous social media account and starts posting stories and comments about a classmate from your school. A few people from your year have started following the account and adding their own posts.
scenarios.target_behavior: Contributing posts or comments to the anonymous account in the next two weeks

items.text: Posting on an anonymous account about someone from school is just how people vent online.
Adding a comment to an account like that is a pretty casual thing to do.
People I look up to would be okay with me posting on a page like that.
Plenty of people at my school would post or comment on an account like that.
It would be easy for me to add a post or comment to the account.
If my friends were all posting on the account, it would be hard for me to stay out of it.
I intend to post or comment on the account in the next two weeks.
I plan to add something to the account if I see it in the next two weeks.

scenarios.text: A group of classmates creates a new online group for hanging out and making plans, but they deliberately leave one classmate out. Everyone in the group knows that person was left out on purpose.
scenarios.target_behavior: Going along with keeping the classmate out of the online group in the next two weeks

items.text: Leaving someone out of a group chat is just how friend groups work.
Keeping someone out of the group is a pretty standard thing to do.
My friends would be fine with me going along with leaving that person out.
Most people I know would just go along with keeping someone out of the group.
It would be easy for me to just go along with keeping that person out.
If everyone in the group wanted to keep that person out, it would be hard for me to stay out of it.
I intend to go along with keeping them out of the group in the next two weeks.
I plan to keep that person out of the group in the next two weeks.
